summary: Build the st3-daemon library with one copy of the per-request task machinery instead of one per route handler, and build its unit test without debug info; the daemon compiles and tests in about 40 percent less memory, with no change to behavior

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or harness change. Handlers return the same values; the closure and its result are boxed once per request.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
